summary: Iteration 4 (Razorpay INR): 53/53 pytest backend tests pass, 1 skipped (ffmpeg not on PATH — environment gap, not a regression). Added 10 new Razorpay tests across TestRazorpayCreateOrder + TestRazorpayVerifyPayment covering: 401 without auth, 400 invalid plan, real create-order returning correct paise amount (daily=3500 / weekly=19900 / monthly=59900), INR currency, plan_name, prefill, key_id, and a persisted pending payment_transactions record with gateway='razorpay'; missing-fields 400; incorrect signature 400 + txn marked failed/signature_mismatch; unknown order 404; end-to-end correct-signature activation via HMAC-SHA256(order_id|payment_id, RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET) — user's plan+plan_expires_at correctly set, billings/current-plan returns Weekly ₹199, idempotent replay does NOT shift expiry, and gatekeeping still enforced (⚠️ exact message) for a fresh no-plan user. Frontend UI (desktop 1920x1080): landing page pricing = ₹35/₹199/₹599 (no $), window.Razorpay function loaded. Dashboard Billings (/dashboard/billings) shows ₹35/₹199/₹599 on all 3 plan cards, data-testids buy-plan-daily/weekly/monthly all present, admin's current Monthly plan correctly disabled. Clicking 'Buy Now' for daily plan successfully opens the Razorpay checkout modal (iframe src = api.razorpay.com/v1/checkout/public, showing Price Summary: 35, Live Adda merchant, admin@liveadda.com prefill, Contact Details step, 'Secured by Razorpay'). Modal was NOT paid (LIVE keys).

minor.issue: ffmpeg binary is NOT installed in this container (which /tmp says command not found) — the request note said 'ffmpeg installed' but it is missing. Test test_start_with_key_success_and_stop is skipped when ffmpeg absent. Unrelated to Razorpay iteration but should be reinstalled if E2E streaming tests are ever needed.

On successful verification the response is always 200 {status:'success'} even for the idempotent (second) call, which is fine, but the response does NOT tell the client whether activation actually happened this call. Adding an 'already_active' or 'activated_now' boolean would help frontend UX distinguish first-time vs. replay. Non-blocking.

Order lookup by (order_id, user_id) — if an authenticated user tries to verify another user's order_id (unlikely because signature would fail first), the 404 path is fine, but consider verifying signature BEFORE the DB write of 'failed'; today an unauthenticated-order + bad signature still writes payment_status='failed' with $set filter on (order_id, user_id) which is a no-op if no match. Confirmed harmless.

issues: Legacy Stripe transactions from previous iterations display with amount prefixed by '₹' (e.g. '₹4.99') because the JSX hardcodes '₹{txn.amount}' — the amount 4.99 was USD from the old Stripe flow. New Razorpay txns are correctly ₹35/199/599. Recommend either (a) render based on txn.currency, or (b) migrate/hide legacy Stripe rows. Cosmetic only.

action_items: (env) Reinstall ffmpeg in this preview container — apt-get install -y ffmpeg — so /api/stream/start-with-key can actually spawn its encoder. Currently missing from PATH.
(cosmetic) Transaction history amount rendering: use txn.currency to pick prefix ($ for USD, ₹ for INR) rather than hardcoded '₹'. Prevents '₹4.99' oddity for legacy Stripe rows.
(nice-to-have) Include an 'activated_now: true|false' flag in the verify-payment response so the toast can differentiate first-verify vs. idempotent replay.
critical_code_review_comments: razorpay_create_order: receipt is 'rcpt_' + 16 hex chars = 21 chars, well within Razorpay's 40-char limit. Good.

razorpay_verify_payment: idempotent activation gate ({status:{$ne:'completed'}}) + modified_count check is the CORRECT pattern — verified via test_verify_correct_signature_activates_plan_idempotently (expiry does NOT shift on replay).
razorpay_verify_payment: transaction lookup uses filter (order_id, user_id) — this enforces that the authenticated user can only activate their OWN order, preventing cross-user replay. Good.
razorpay_webhook: correctly no-ops when RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset (returns 'ignored') rather than 500-ing. Good defensive check.

frontend Billings.jsx: window.Razorpay presence check + toast fallback + processing spinner + payment.failed handler + ondismiss handler is a solid checkout integration. handler correctly calls razorpayAPI.verifyPayment and refreshUser.
server.py is now ~1251 lines — still recommend splitting into APIRouter modules (auth/videos/payments/razorpay/youtube/live-slot/billings/support/dashboard). Flagged since iteration 2.
on_event('startup')/on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI — migrate to lifespan handler. Flagged since iteration 2 still not addressed.

PLANS dict still has legacy 'price' (USD) fields alongside new 'inr'. If Stripe is fully retired from UI, the USD field could be removed to prevent accidental use. It IS still used by legacy /api/payments/checkout-session (Stripe), so keep for now but document.
PLANS['daily']['inr'] = 35 -> paise 3500 matches request; weekly 199->19900; monthly 599->59900. Verified via parametrized test.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (landing INR pricing, dashboard billings INR + data-testids + disabled current plan + Razorpay modal opens with correct amount)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@liveadda.com / admin123 (monthly plan seeded on startup). Fresh users created per-test with TEST_ prefix (rzuser_, rzgate_, freshuser_, keyuser_) — all cleaned up in fixtures.
seed_data_creation: TestRazorpayVerifyPayment uses a class-scoped rz_fresh_user fixture that registers TEST_rzuser_<hex>@example.com and cleans up user + payment_transactions rows on teardown. The activation E2E test additionally resets user.plan=null before running to guarantee a clean starting state. test_no_plan_user_still_gated_after_failed_verify uses a separate ephemeral session (TEST_rzgate_<hex>) so the just-activated user is not contaminated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 adds Razorpay LIVE-mode INR payment gateway as the PRIMARY checkout. Signature test pattern (safe, no real payment needed): (1) POST /api/razorpay/create-order -> real order_id, (2) sig = HMAC_SHA256(secret=RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET_from_env, msg=f'{order_id}|{any_fake_payment_id}').hexdigest(), (3) POST /api/razorpay/verify-payment {razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, razorpay_signature} — activates plan. This is fully deterministic and does NOT charge the card. Frontend Billings page is at /dashboard/billings (NOT /billings — nested inside DashboardLayout). data-testids: buy-plan-daily / buy-plan-weekly / buy-plan-monthly, plan-card-{id}, current-plan-card, no-active-plan-card, billings-page, payment-processing-overlay. Clicking a buy button opens window.Razorpay checkout — DO NOT click 'Continue' inside the modal (LIVE keys = real money). ffmpeg is NOT installed in this container — test_start_with_key_success_and_stop is now guarded with pytest.skip. Stripe endpoints (/api/payments/checkout-session, /api/webhook/stripe) still exist and are covered by TestPayments/TestStripeWebhook; they are no longer used by the UI. Legacy PLANS['price'] (USD) still exists for Stripe compatibility; new PLANS['inr'] drives all Razorpay + billings/current-plan responses.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in iteration 4. Two pre-existing iteration-3 tests were updated to reflect intentional main-agent improvements: (a) test_stop_stream_no_active_returns_404 -> renamed to test_stop_stream_no_active_is_idempotent because /api/stream/stop was made idempotent (200 'Already stopped') per the iteration-3 recommendation — this is a spec improvement, not a regression; (b) test_start_with_key_success_and_stop now skips when ffmpeg is missing from PATH — the container lost ffmpeg between iterations 3 and 4 (which /tmp shows 'command not found'). All 10 new Razorpay tests + 43 regression tests pass.
